text:
sara_cs: Quick heads-up — SilverStream (payments) asked for a short demo uplift next week. They rotate IP addresses so requested a header-based allowlist + regional routing (EU + LATAM).
sara_cs: AE flagged this as high impact for renewal — want ops to prioritize.
mike_support: What QPS and windows? Header name/value?
sara_cs: Customer estimates ~220 sustained, 320 peak for a 3.5–4h window. Proposed slots: 2026-06-22 15:00-19:30 UTC. AE will confirm header value; placeholder x-silver-demo: ss-demo-2026.
raj_eng: Technical plan: header allowlist + soft QPS bump. Route traffic to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1. Pin model to v2-small to cap latency, and run KV cache warmup 20m before start with AE-provided prompts.
jana_oncall: Ops guardrails: canary 10% for 8m, autorevert after 48h by default; AE can request extension to 96h if demo converts. Alerts: p50 > 220ms OR 5xx spike > 0.8% -> page oncall. Add DoS ceilings per session.
mike_support: Draft override payload we'll apply (AE to confirm header):

```
POST /v1/overrides
{
  "customer": "silverstream",
  "regions": ["eu-west-1", "sa-east-1"],
  "allowlist": "header x-silver-demo=ss-demo-2026",
  "rate_override": "qps=320 burst=550",
  "duration": "48h",
  "autorevert": "true"
}
```

mike_support: Plan: push to staging canary -> validate (10% for 8m) -> promote to prod. TTL for allowlist set to 6d.
deploy-bot: change-request 3344556677: applying route override to staging canary (10%).
deploy-bot: change-success 3344556692: staging canary healthy after 8m. No errors.
mike_support: Promoting to prod now and scheduling autorevert 48h out. Creating ticket CS-1678 with rollout and contact info.
deploy-bot: change-success 3344556720: prod override applied to eu-west-1 and sa-east-1. Smoke checks passed.
sara_cs: Added runbook link and renewal note to the customer file: https://playbooks.internal/silverstream-demo-runbook. AE @ae_claire will confirm header value and send warmup prompts.
jana_oncall: I added rollback steps and alert hooks to the runbook. If AE requests extension, we'll require written approval and a short risk review.
sara_cs: I'll follow up with AE and close this thread once demo outcome is known. :thumbsup:
